title: The Master Carpenter

scenes.text: A skilled carpenter carefully measures a piece of oak wood with his ruler.
He marks the cutting lines with precision using a sharp pencil.
The man picks up his handsaw and begins cutting the wood with steady strokes.
He smooths the edges with sandpaper creating a perfect wooden plank.
Finally he steps back to admire his crafted work with a satisfied smile.
